Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2025_2t_csv.zip (sha256 f21c64dfdd6d181322dbdab55cc7d129c83b7478d646bb264ea161cf66268c62, fetched 2026-09-28), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (variable labels), catalogos/bp2_*.csv (value labels) and conjunto_de_datos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (raw data, sha256 4b301b2395320f17744a97cf5cd6f3b06b588274ff620b4b1f13aaa3d6002430).
note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #6, Q2 2025 Conflicts) keeps INEGI columns bp2_1..bp2_4_11 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0625.csv (imported lowercased) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes (Section II, all quarters): bp2_1 9 -> missing, bp2_3_* 9 -> missing. The bookmark's export filename is mexico_2025_q2conflicts.csv, not the IRW table name; the live table's contents match it (below). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's own 2025 Q2 data dictionary labels each BP2_* column (e.g. BP2_2_16 'Conflictos o enfrentamientos: Grafiti o pintas a su casa por alguien que usted identifique'; BP2_3_4 'Incidentes o problemas con desconocidos(as) en la calle'; BP2_4_09 'Tipo de consecuencias derivadas de conflictos: Dialogo/platica'); 37/37 labels agree in content with the 2025 Q2 questionnaire option carrying the same code number. 2025 Q2 vs 2025 Q1 source check (done, not assumed): same 37 BP2_* variables; all 37 BP2_* diccionario rows identical to Q1 2025's (the dictionary changes between the quarters are all outside Section II: BP1_6_*, BP3_3..BP3_6, BP4_1_4..9); all 37 catalogos/bp2_*.csv byte-identical to Q1 2025's. Questionnaire Section II: CP2 introduction, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 stems and all 18+7+11 options identical to Q1 2025 except two print changes, both confirmed on a 150-dpi render of p.3: (a) the 2.2 stem's typo 'familares' (2024 Q1/Q2, 2025 Q1) is corrected to 'familiares' -- the 2.2 stem now equals the 2024 Q3/Q4 print (batch_680/685) character for character; (b) option 15 now reads 'prepotencia de un (una) servidor(a) publico(a)?' where every earlier quarter (2024 Q1-Q4, 2025 Q1) printed 'un(a)' -- shipped as printed. All 38 distinct Spanish strings shipped (CP2 intro, 3 section stems, 34 distinct item texts) are found in the 2025 Q2 text layer after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation (bp2_2_12's 'producto/' + 'servicio' line wrap joined without a space, as the siblings did). Cross-check (route 9 style): all 74 live item x level counts (queried server-side via GROUP BY item,resp, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q2 CSV after the .do's recodes, 74/74 (e.g. bp2_1 1/2 = 9677/14035, bp2_2_18 0/1 = 7963/1714, bp2_2_16 0/1 = 9064/613, bp2_4_09 0/1 = 3352/4611); raw has 23717 rows, 5 bp2_1=9 set missing -> 23712 live distinct ids = live bp2_1 n (341218 live rows, no missing resp, no duplicate id x item); 2 respondents with bp2_3_*=9 on all 7 bp2_3 items set missing (bp2_3 n = 7961 vs bp2_4 n = 7963). No truncation (cf. batch_692). Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials), not the terser dictionary labels. Kept as printed: '(as)' gender fills, 'un (una)', trailing '?' on 2.2 options and the stem's trailing ellipsis. Normalised: line wraps joined. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blanks after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'B' Y CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO / LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASE A LA SECCION III; SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 18 'NINGUNO', PASE A LA SECCION III). Structure (same as batch_672/676/680/685/689): section _1 = 2.1 screener (stem in item_text), _2 = 2.2 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _3 = 2.3, _4 = 2.4; instructions = CP2 read-aloud introduction. Options: bp2_1 1=Si, 2=No (questionnaire and catalogo; 9 'No sabe / no responde' set missing by the .do, no row). The 36 checklist items are 0/1 flags; option_text is INEGI's catalogo value label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si'), not questionnaire print. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Routing (not a defect): 2.2 asked only if 2.1=Si (n=9677 = bp2_1 Si count); 2.3/2.4 skipped when 2.2 code 18 'Ninguno' was circled (7963 = 9677 - 1714). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (37 = 1 + 18 + 7 + 11); dictionary Description ('Q2 2025') is accurate, but the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q2 (junio 2025, file suffix 0625) wave -- same defect as the 2024/2025 Q1 siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_685/689 for every field (74/74 rows identical to batch_685's English); nothing translated fresh -- the two Spanish print changes do not change the English ('family members'; 'a public servant'). INEGI publishes no English questionnaire. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv INEGI row verdict=ship (Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R01; INEGI Terminos de libre uso, attribution only), applied not re-derived; credit condition applied in public_note.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, segundo trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section II (questions 2.1-2.4) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
